products.description:
Importing live plants into South Africa requires strict adherence to the Agricultural Pests Act and the Department of Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development (DALRRD). We take the stress out of international plant sourcing by handling the bureaucratic paperwork for you.

Our Facilitation Service Includes:

Preliminary consultation to check if your desired plant species is permitted for import into South Africa.

Preparation and submission of the DALRRD Plant Import Permit application on your behalf.

Payment of the standard DALRRD government permit application fee.

Guidance on the exact Phytosanitary Certificate requirements you need to give to your international supplier.

Step-by-step advice on the customs clearance and quarantine process to ensure your plants are not destroyed at the border.

Terms and Conditions

Base Fee Scope: The R2,500 starting fee covers standard administrative facilitation and the basic government permit application fee. Complex imports requiring post-entry quarantine facility arrangements may incur additional consulting fees.

Third-Party Costs Excluded: This fee does not include international shipping, customs clearing agent fees, port health inspection fees, duties, or physical quarantine facility fees. These remain the responsibility of the importer.

Government Authority: While we ensure your application is 100% compliant, the final decision to issue an import permit rests solely with DALRRD. We cannot guarantee permit approval for restricted species.

Information Accuracy: The client is responsible for providing the exact botanical names, quantities, and registered supplier details. Any amendments required due to client error will incur government amendment fees (currently R410).

Refund Policy: Due to the administrative nature of this service, fees are non-refundable once the application has been drafted and submitted to the government department.
